findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance, discarding logged messages
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()` instead of the receiver `f`. When code under test logs via `logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` (such as `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` in `pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go`), the log call is recorded on a newly allocated, unreachable `TestLogger` rather than the `TestLogger` instance held by the test, so assertions on `f.InfoLogs` / `f.ErrorLogs` will see zero calls and empty messages.

findings.title: Nil request dereference in ContextualLoggerMiddleware methods
findings.body: `ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` unconditionally dereference `req.PluginContext` before passing `req` to `m.next`. Other client middlewares (for example `LoggerMiddleware` in `logger_middleware.go` lines 63, 77, 90, 104) explicitly guard against `req == nil` and forward nil requests to `m.next`. Because `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` is registered ahead of `LoggerMiddleware` in the middleware chain, a nil `req` will now panic with a nil pointer dereference in `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` before reaching those guards.
